input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts, outside the accepted set (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and close to the walk-away position of foreign law with exclusive foreign venue. It also conflicts with Section 28.2, which already vests exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County. The edit now substitutes only the two words identifying the jurisdiction and forum ("Singapore" to "New York" / "New York County, New York"), reaching the preferred position while leaving the rest of 28.1 and all of 28.2 and 28.3 untouched; the state/federal court detail is already supplied by 28.2.

ops.newText: courts of New York County, New York

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have swapped Singapore for New York as the governing law and forum, our standard position, which also removes the conflict with the exclusive New York County jurisdiction already agreed in Section 28.2. If New York is not workable, we can accept Delaware or California law and courts, or English law with the courts of London.
proposal.summary: Swap the two Singapore references in 28.1 for New York law and the courts of New York County, leaving the sentence otherwise untouched.
